video_title: Philadelphia 76ers Postgame Media Availability 🎙️ | Labaron Philon Jr. | 10.25.26

quotes.speaker: Labaron Philon Jr.
quotes.summary_phrase: Labaron Philon Jr. on adjusting to the NBA rotation
quotes.excerpt: it felt good just being out there, competing with the guys, but mainly myself just getting a feel
quotes.quote: It felt good just being out there, competing with the guys, but mainly myself just getting a feel of the game and it is going to come along. I know it is a long season. Just staying ready, staying with a great mindset and coming in every day ready to work. I feel like that does not have to change, even if you get in the game or you are not in the game. Just give energy and come to work every day and that has been my mindset so far in the beginning, but like I said, it is a long season, so just being ready.
quotes.social_post: Labaron Philon Jr. on his early NBA adjustment: It felt good just being out there competing. I know it is a long season and my mindset is just staying ready and coming in every day ready to work.

structured.context: Labaron Philon Jr. discusses his mindset and adjustment to the NBA rotation during his postgame media availability.

quotes.speaker: Labaron Philon Jr.
quotes.summary_phrase: Labaron Philon Jr. on his defensive impact and hustle plays
quotes.excerpt: trying to get up there and pressure, trying to make guys feel ball pressure and stuff like that
quotes.quote: I think I played really well. Just trying to get up there and pressure, trying to make guys feel ball pressure and stuff like that. And like I said, just trying to make the extra plays, like you say, getting tips and steals and stuff like that. So continuing to do that for me would be a great thing. As a young guy trying to fit into a team with a lot of vets, so you got to find a way to impact the game without scoring and stuff like that. So being able to try to get my hands on tips and stuff like that has been really well.
quotes.social_post: Labaron Philon Jr. on finding his role as a rookie: As a young guy trying to fit into a team with a lot of vets you have to find a way to impact the game without scoring. I am focusing on ball pressure and getting my hands on tips.

structured.context: Labaron Philon Jr. explains his focus on defensive intensity and making hustle plays to impact the game as a rookie.

quotes.speaker: Labaron Philon Jr.
quotes.summary_phrase: Labaron Philon Jr. on adjusting to the physicality of the Pistons
quotes.excerpt: it is going to be adjustment for sure, but just staying calm and being physical back
quotes.quote: They were really physical. I feel like every team we have played, I think Cleveland was kind of physical, but I would just say it is going to be adjustment for sure, but just staying calm and being physical back to the on the other side of the ball really. I really think that matters when you are playing against a physical team, showing that your team can also be physical. So just for us, up in that, it would be very great.
quotes.social_post: Labaron Philon Jr. on the physicality of the Pistons: It is an adjustment for sure but you have to stay calm and be physical back. It matters when you are playing against a physical team to show that your team can also be physical.

structured.context: Labaron Philon Jr. reflects on the physicality of recent opponents including the Pistons and Cavaliers.

quotes.speaker: Labaron Philon Jr.
quotes.summary_phrase: Labaron Philon Jr. on the adjustment from college to the NBA
quotes.excerpt: just the way the days are and the games and stuff like that
quotes.quote: I would say just the way the days are and the games and stuff like that. I think this was my first back-to-back, so really just like getting up, having a game and then going home like this at 10:00 or 11:00 and then you wake up and you maybe forget. I woke up today and I was like, okay, and then, oh, we got a game. It is a back-to-back. So really I would say that would be the only thing. Other than that, it has been a great process and just seeing myself continue to figure it out, I think it has been great.
quotes.social_post: Labaron Philon Jr. on the transition to the NBA schedule: My first back to back was an adjustment. Waking up and realizing we have a game right away is different but it has been a great process figuring it out.

structured.context: Labaron Philon Jr. describes the adjustment to the NBA schedule, specifically his experience with his first back-to-back game.

quotes.speaker: Labaron Philon Jr.
quotes.summary_phrase: Labaron Philon Jr. on learning from veteran teammates
quotes.excerpt: being a young guy for me and being around all these great players is definitely a thing
quotes.quote: Being a young guy for me and being around all these great players is definitely a thing for me to learn from them and pick up everything that I can try to gain from them. But I would say being on a winning team excites me more than just like a lot of minutes on a team that is not really winning or with great vets like I got now. And like you said, the superstar caliber players that are on the floor with every night and competing against in practice. So I feel like I will trend that way more than just trying to be on a team like you said, just getting all the minutes and stuff like that just because it can really hurt you.
quotes.social_post: Labaron Philon Jr. on his development: Being on a winning team excites me more than just getting a lot of minutes on a team that is not winning. Learning from superstar caliber players is better for me than just chasing stats.

structured.context: Labaron Philon Jr. discusses the value of playing on a winning team alongside veteran superstars rather than prioritizing individual minutes.

quotes.speaker: Labaron Philon Jr.
quotes.summary_phrase: Labaron Philon Jr. on team rebounding and defensive challenges
quotes.excerpt: we need a lot more guys to come in and help rebounding
quotes.quote: My challenge, really just trying to impact the game on the other side of the ball, not offense, on the defensive side of the ball. But as a team, I would say we need a lot more guys to come in and help rebounding. They did a great job on the glass and really just like finding their shooters. I feel like Duncan Robinson got a lot of threes off, so he is a great shooter and when you let guys get looks like that, they are going to knock them down. But just continuing all the other guys too, really just like bringing it all together like as a team, just playing a great, well-to-the game.
quotes.social_post: Labaron Philon Jr. identifies areas for improvement after the loss: We need a lot more guys to come in and help rebounding. We also have to do a better job of finding shooters and not letting guys get open looks.

structured.context: Labaron Philon Jr. identifies team rebounding and defensive coverage of shooters like Duncan Robinson as areas for improvement.
